hero.title: The marketplace where every bid counts
hero.subtitle: Auctions and fixed-price deals from verified people across Egypt. Pay cash on delivery.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Create an account and verify your ID. Everyone who bids or sells here is a real person.
how.step2Body: Set your maximum and we bid for you, or buy straight away at the fixed price.
how.step3Body: Confirm your win on WhatsApp and pay cash when the parcel arrives.

verify.title: Verify your identity
verify.intro: Upload clear photos of your ID. Our team reviews them, usually within one day.
verify.numberHint: National ID: the 14 digits on the front.
verify.privacy: Your photos are stored privately and only our review team can open them. We keep a protected fingerprint of the number, never the number itself.
verify.pending: Your ID is under review. We will let you know as soon as it is done.
verify.approved: Your identity is verified. You can bid, buy and sell.
verify.rejected: Your last submission was rejected: {reason} You can send it again.

listing.wonBy: The auction has ended and the winner is confirming.

bid.depositHeld: Your deposit is held. You can bid.
